visualCharacteristics.purpose: Horizontal track of round icon chips that filter the cards-product cards on the same page by category
visualCharacteristics.description: Large outlined search input with magnifier icon; horizontal track of 11 round icon chips with labels (Destaques selected, light blue); count line '10 servicos disponiveis'; 3-column grid of bordered product cards with image, optional badge (NOVIDADE / Compre e Ganhe!), category eyebrow, title, price label + price, optional instalment text, grey benefit box (20% de desconto com Cartao Porto Bank) and full-width blue 'Compre agora' button.

contentPattern.structure: one row per chip. Cell 1: icon image. Cell 2: label, optionally linked to #<category-slug> (e.g. #ar-condicionado). The slug is the link hash, or the label slugified (accents removed). The first chip (Destaques) is the default and shows all cards; other chips show cards whose category eyebrow slug matches. The URL hash selects a chip, so links elsewhere on the page (hero CTAs) to #<slug> activate it
contentPattern.source: One row per chip: cell 1 icon image, cell 2 label (linked to #<category-slug>, e.g. #ar-condicionado, #destaques; the hero CTAs link to these anchors). Destaques is selected by default.

usage: Place between search-services and cards-product. Chip slugs must match the category eyebrow text of the product cards (e.g. chip "Ar-condicionado" matches eyebrow "Ar-condicionado").
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any category filter driving cards-product. Communicates via the document event `services:category`.
